ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$3.02 (voucher) for the unexempted detour mileage on this RydeTAXI trip; note the RD-1 breach; no account flag required.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat, complaint and driver statement contain no threat, abuse, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation — safety_concern = none.

Service type is RydeTAXI (metered), so detour mileage feeds the fare (RD-2 taxi branch). The driver's GPS trace runs: after pickup (14:21) it follows the quoted corridor (AYER RAJAH EXPRESSWAY / JURONG TOWN HALL ROAD) south-west, but at ~14:29:55–14:33:55 it turns north-east and loops around the Clementi Road / AYE interchange area (points at 1.30836,103.76587 and 1.31188,103.76854 are ~1.3 km east/north of the route), then rejoins the quoted corridor near 1.306/103.771 and continues to NUS. That north-east loop plus the rejoin is ~4.6 km of driving in the wrong direction to recover ~2.5 km of line, i.e. ~2.1 km of excess distance (seg1). No LTA incident covers the replaced optimal segment (incidents empty; the band-2 AYE record is only corroborative and cannot exempt on its own, RD-4(b)/(c)), and no rider message named any stop.

Consent (RD-5): the rider's "Sure, no problem." is timestamped 14:31:35, after the deviation had already begun (off-corridor from ~14:29:55, and the driver's own chat "can I go round via Clementi Road?" was sent only at 14:30:55, once the car was already off the route). Consent must precede the detour, so this is consent-after, which does not exempt the segment. Even read as a general route choice, a "whichever way is faster" authorisation covers routing to the destination, not a loop that goes away from it, so the wrong-direction loop is not covered either.

Amount (RD-2, RydeTAXI): excess ≈ 2.1 km × per-km rate (fare.distance_fare 14.95 ÷ fare.distance_km 10.6 = S$1.41/km) ≈ S$2.96–3.02. Awarding S$3.02 for the unexempted segment. The metered waiting fee (S$0.11) is not disputed and stays (RD-3(c)). Rider profile route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so RD-6 does not attach a flag. Distance figures are estimated from the thinned GPS trace (51 of 296 points), which is the main source of uncertainty.

segment_findings.reason: North-east loop off the quoted corridor (~14:29:55–14:33:55) then rejoin; the rider's 'Sure, no problem.' (14:31:35) postdates the start of the deviation, and the driver's route proposal (14:30:55) was itself sent after the car had already turned off, so consent does not precede the segment (RD-5). No traffic incident covers the replaced optimal segment (RD-4). Segment is unexempted, ~2.1 km extra counted under RD-1/RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: A driver's claim that the rider agreed (verbally or in chat) is not consent under RD-5/G11 unless the rider's own message precedes the detour; here the rider's message (14:31:35) came after the car had already left the route.
The band-2 AYER RAJAH EXPRESSWAY record covers the optimal route but is only corroborative and cannot exempt a segment on its own (RD-4(b)); no LTA incident exists (RD-4(a)).
